Louise — thanks for the PO and the question. Short answer: we can support both workflows, but each has tradeoffs.

Portal (recommended):
- Pros: automated invoice ingestion (PDF/XML), searchable tax metadata (VAT id mapped to entity), and machine-readable evidence upload.
- Cons: your AP team needs an SSO invite or portal credentials; some SAP teams won't accept portal-only flows.

Email (PDF copies to AP inbox):
- Pros: simple for locked-down SAP setups — invoices arrive to the inbox and can be picked up by your AP automation.
- Cons: manual VAT evidence handling in some cases; we can include VAT certificate as a PDF in the invoice bundle.

We typically offer a hybrid on onboarding: we deliver invoices as emailed PDF copies to your AP inbox and also provision read-only portal access for your procurement and finance teams so they have a single place to pull history and evidence. If that sounds acceptable, please confirm: 1) AP inbox for invoices (email address); 2) billing contact for remittance and PO matching (name, title, phone); and 3) whether you will upload VAT cert to the portal or include it on email.

If you prefer portal-first, we can send an invite link and a short SSO setup doc — see staging invite (will expire in 7 days): https://redwood.example.com/billing-portal/invite/HLX-98765

I CC'd Marissa from Sales so she can note the delivery choice on the contract and coordinate billing handoff.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
